_source: Story 019. Addendum 'Progression, upgrades and loot': normal enemies drop something 35% of the time, elites 100%; rarity odds per drop Normal 70/25/5, Elite 20/65/15; pity: 15 elite kills without an Epic guarantees the next. An enemy's own 'drops' table (in its enemy JSON) wins per rarity; a rarity it does not list falls back to the zone pool. Weights are relative within one rarity. Budget (decision D-026): a Crawler kill gives a Lesser Soul Shard 35% x 70% x 1/3 = 8.2% of the time.
